channel.title: Same Second Shipping
channel.description: Posts in the discussion thread "Same Second Shipping" - A coupon code that when entered online, the package will immediately be delivered.

item.title: Re: Same Second Shipping
item.content:encoded:
This coupon would be so useful lmao

Ok, some considerations: how do people acquire this coupon? Is it readily available on the site you buy stuff from or is it outsourced? Does the buyer chose to use it or it just happens? Is there any catches or tricks to it? A price of any dark or evil nature? As is it sounds just like a consumer's dream but it hardly makes for an interesting story. There needs to be some conflict or narrative arc following the idea or else it will be a very short a bland.
Try formatting this idea according to the guidelines and you'll see what points you need to work on.

item.title: Re: Same Second Shipping
item.content:encoded:
Since it was a safe and mundane SCP, I thought the Foundation wouldnt be interested.

My mistake.

item.title: Re: Same Second Shipping
item.content:encoded: Keter does not mean dangerous. It means hard to contain. The foundation contains all anomalies no matter the threat. Scp-4999 is keter yet isn’t dangerous. The man who delivered the package, is unknown and obviously anomalous.

item.title: Re: Same Second Shipping
item.content:encoded:
why it should be contained?

The Foundation contains all anomalies, no matter how mundane. That's just what the Foundation does. In this case, a coupon that causes immediate delivery of the ordered item is pretty clearly anomalous.

Second why its an object class keter? It could be very well classified as safe.

Presumably because the coupon code changes daily, so it's near impossible to reliably contain.

item.title: Re: Same Second Shipping
item.content:encoded:
Okay, theres a lot of missing things here but let's go.

First if its just a coupon that delivers what you ordered, why it should be contained? I just don't see why the Foundation should be interested.

Second why its an object class keter? It could be very well classified as safe.

Also take a look at the forum guidelines like the staff said to create a proper idea for feedback. ;)

item.title: Forum Criticism Team - Staff Post

Author, per the required reading forum guidelines: http://www.scp-wiki.net/forum/t-13282684/required-reading:how-to-use-this-forum-ideas please fill out the concept template to seek feedback on your idea:

 **Seeking Greenlights:** Put yes or no. **Page Type:** SCP Article, Tale, GoI Format, Joke SCP, Site Dossier, Other (specify) **Genre (Optional):** Horror, Drama/Emotional, Comedy, Action, History, Other (specify) **Page Layout (Optional):** [How will you will structure the page in terms of information presentation, or plot development? If you plan on using a unique format/format screw, describe that here.] **Elevator Pitch:** [What is the basic core idea? Use a bullet point list if necessary.] **Central Narrative:** [Describe the story beats or overarching context/"big picture" for your piece. If there is no story content, put "none".] **Hook/Attention-Grabber:** [What is novel/unique about your premise? What is special about your idea here that will make it stand out among the other works already on the mainsite?] **Additional Notes:** [Note any concerns or particular areas of assistance you would like reviewers to focus on.]

Remember to please edit your previous post using the "edit" function under the "options" tab to the lower right of your first comment rather than creating a new thread.

Also, please mind the wordcount limit— the combined text for your answers to the last four sections (Elevator Pitch, Central Narrative, Hook/Attention-Grabber, and Additional Notes) MAY NOT exceed 400 words. For convenience, authors can use this page to check wordcount: https://wordcounter.net/

Once you have revised your post accordingly, please reach out to reviewers to request that they look at your thread. You can find a list of ways to contact reviewers in this thread: http://www.scp-wiki.net/forum/t-13282692/how-to-get-more-reviews

item.title: Same Second Shipping
item.content:encoded: The package will be delivered right as the order is confirmed, or even, in rare cases, before the order is placed. The delivery man who hand delivers the package is unidentifiable and is considered a sub-SCP who only appears when code is used. Sub scp can not be changed and coupon code changes daily. Object class keter.
